title: Seller Performance Standing Levels: Volume, Sales and Profile-Age Requirements and the Evaluation Calendar
content:
Seller Performance Standing levels differ not only in their performance limits but in the trading history and profile age a seller must show to be placed at them. The requirements and the evaluation calendar are as follows.

## Requirements by level

| Requirement | Below Standard Level | Developing Seller Level | Standard Level | Above Standard Level | Top Rated Level | Preferred Partner Level |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Minimum orders over the trailing 12 months | 0 | 0 | 100 | 100 | 100 | 1000 |
| Minimum gross sales over the trailing 12 months | 0 USD | 0 USD | 0 USD | 0 USD | 1000 USD | 100000 USD |
| Minimum seller profile age, calendar days | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 90 | 365 |
| Maximum seller profile age, calendar days | not applicable | 364 | not applicable | not applicable | not applicable | not applicable |

- **Minimum orders** — the minimum orders over the trailing 12 months required at the level (integer).
- **Minimum gross sales** — the minimum gross sales over the trailing 12 months required at the level, USD.
- **Minimum profile age** — the minimum seller profile age in calendar days from the account opened date required at the level (integer).
- **Maximum profile age** — the maximum seller profile age in calendar days for the level; not applicable when there is no maximum. Only Developing Seller Level has one: 364 days.

## Calendar and placement terms (the same at every level)

| Term | Value at every level, Below Standard Level through Preferred Partner Level |
|---|---|
| Evaluation day of the month | the 20th |
| How the level is chosen | the highest level whose every gate is met, else Below Standard Level |
| How long an evaluated level applies | from the evaluation date until the next evaluation |
| Level at the first evaluation of a seller whose profile is younger than the Developing maximum age | Developing Seller Level |

## Worked readings (hypothetical sellers)

- A seller with 1000 orders and 100000 USD of gross sales over the trailing 12 months and a profile 364 days old meets the order and sales minimums of Preferred Partner Level but not its minimum profile age of 365 days; the profile-age gate of Top Rated Level (90 days) is met.
- A seller with 99 orders over the trailing 12 months is short of the 100-order minimum shared by Standard Level, Above Standard Level and Top Rated Level; exactly 100 orders meets it.
- A seller whose profile is 364 days old is within the Developing Seller Level maximum; at 365 days that maximum is exceeded.
